* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 December 2021): Players Committee card image, 20 December 2021: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-bluesquadron1.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f54fd7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/bluesquadron1.png Holotable commit 6f54fd7 “Set 17 images”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 1 pilot. Snap deploys free aboard. While Snap piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at opponent's system within 1 parsec of Snap.” '''What changed:''' “at another system” became “at opponent's system”; re-rendered at 745×1039 (was 350×490) with the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”.
